brand_identity.name: Léomentia Event
brand_identity.mission: Create elegant, emotional, and premium wedding experiences that inspire trust and serenity.
brand_identity.tone: Elegant, Romantic, High-end, Minimalist, Serene, Professional

usage_rules.headings: Use Poiret One for all H1-H6. Letter spacing should be slightly wide (tracking-wide) for elegance. Font weight usually 400 (Regular) as the font is naturally decorative.
usage_rules.body: Use Asap for all paragraphs, labels, and buttons. Keep line-height loose (leading-relaxed) for readability.
usage_rules.hero_text: H1 should be large (text-5xl to text-7xl) and emotive.
usage_rules.section_titles: H2 should be elegant, often centered or accompanied by a decorative line.

usage.background: Use 'cream' (#FFFCF8) as the main page background to avoid harsh stark white.
usage.text: Use 'coffee' (#3d211a) for almost all text. Never use pure black.
usage.buttons: Primary buttons: Gold background, Coffee text. Secondary: Coffee border, Coffee text.
usage.accents: Use Gold for icons, thin borders, and decorative lines.

layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris) for galleries and feature sections. Use generous padding (p-12 to p-24) between sections.

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded-md (radius-sm). Elegant, not bubbly.
buttons.classes: font-asap font-medium tracking-wide uppercase text-sm px-8 py-3 transition-all duration-300

cards.style: Minimalist. White background, very subtle border (border-coffee/10), soft shadow (shadow-sm).

navigation.links: Poiret One or Asap. Hover: text-gold transition-colors.

forms.style: Minimalist inputs. No background (bg-transparent), bottom border only (border-b border-coffee/20) OR clean white inputs with thin coffee borders.

visual_enhancers.textures: Consider a very subtle grain overlay on the 'cream' background for a paper-like feel.

guidelines.scroll: Elements should gently fade up (y: 20 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1) as they enter viewport.
guidelines.parallax: Use subtle parallax on large background images in the Hero or Quote sections.

hero_background.alt: Romantic silhouette of bride and groom at sunset
hero_background.usage: Full width hero background with overlay

about_founder.usage: About section, circular or arch mask

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import link to the <head> of public/index.html immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the 'coffee', 'peach', 'gold', and 'cream' colors defined in the colors section. Extend the font family to include 'Poiret One' and 'Asap'.
3. GLOBAL STYLES: Update index.css to set the body background to 'cream' and text to 'coffee'. Remove default React styles.
4. ICONS: Use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Keep them thin (stroke-width={1.5}) to match the elegance of the brand.
5. COMPONENTS: Build the 'Services' section using the 'Bento Grid' layout. Do not use simple rows.
6. IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs. Do not use placeholders.
7. NAVIGATION: Create a transparent-to-glass sticky navbar. It should be transparent at the top and become glassmorphic on scroll.
8. TESTIMONIALS: Use a carousel (embla-carousel-react) for testimonials to save vertical space.
9. CONTACT: The contact form must be elegant. Use 'gold' for the active border color.
10. FOOTER: Large footer with 'Poiret One' logo, social links, and a 'Let's create magic together' CTA.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI slop' designs. No default blue/gray buttons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than usual. This is a luxury brand.
Do not use purple or teal. Stick strictly to the Coffee/Gold/Peach palette.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast against the cream background.
